description: A public TrackDIFF persona (a streamer or pro player) by site slug or display name: their linked Riot accounts with region, current tier/division/LP and whether they played recently, live status per platform (Twitch/Kick/SOOP) with stream title and start time, social links, esports team, best champion-board standing, and recent clips. Only accounts the owner made public are listed. `found: false` means no persona matches — try `search` with the name. For one account's ranked detail call `get_player_profile` with its Riot ID.

name.description: The persona slug from a trackdiff.com/p/<slug> URL, or the display name (e.g. "Tyler1").

name: get_persona
title: Streamer / pro persona
